comments.text: If you could spend one weekend exploring modern China, which experience would you choose first?

comments.author: @TheCivilizedMind
comments.text: Many young people in China face a difficult choice: chase a high-paying career in an expensive city, or choose a simpler life with less financial pressure. If you were in their position, what would matter more — money, freedom, love, or peace of mind?
